scripts.demo: rm -f /tmp/tpl-dummy-port && bunx --bun concurrently -k -n DEV,BE,FE -c yellow,green,cyan "python dummy_device.py --port-file /tmp/tpl-dummy-port" "bash scripts/demo-backend.sh" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev: bunx --bun concurrently -k -n FE,BE -c cyan,green "bun run dev:frontend" "bun run dev:backend"
scripts.lint: bun run lint:frontend && bun run lint:backend
scripts.lint:frontend: cd frontend && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend/ dummy_device.py
scripts.test: bun run test:frontend && bun run test:backend
